kokoro-tts.description: Local TTS for trailers and in-game voice lines (zero API cost, CPU-friendly)
kokoro-tts.release_note: int8-quantized English model (kokoro-v1.0.int8.onnx, 109MB) — 65% smaller download than the 326MB full model, no quality regression expected for voiceover/voice-line use. English voices file (voices-v1.0.bin) unchanged. Skipped: fp16 variant (163MB) and kokoro-v1.1-zh (Chinese).

edge-tts.description: Microsoft Edge Read Aloud TTS (network service, MP3 output) — fallback when Kokoro voices don't fit
edge-tts.license: Microsoft (use per Edge terms; licensing unresolved — never call it cleared)
edge-tts.release_note: No download — a live network service (wss://speech.platform.bing.com). May be blocked from datacenter IPs; prefer kokoro-tts (offline). `pip install edge-tts` CLI improves reliability.
